title: Intervention decisions and engineer workspace
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-5 met: a diagnosis without evidence says 'insufficient data' and names what is missing; every option states its basis (test, analogue or model) and an option without one is refused; an estimated gain carries its unit; a decision records its rationale, owner and target date; and a work order carries the decision it was raised from and cannot be raised twice, including the case where the creation is not acknowledged and is retried.

dataModel.decision: PRD-06 needed its own records: no table in the repository holds an intervention decision, its candidate options or a method code book. All three were added to the ProductionOperations module that already owns the deferment (PRD-03) records, because the diagnosis reads that module's evidence and the decision belongs to the same production operations surface.
tables: INTERVENTION_DECISION (DECISION_ID key, FIELD_ID, WELL_ID, CHOSEN_OPTION_ID, RATIONALE, OWNER, TARGET_DATE, STATE, WORK_ORDER_REF, WORK_ORDER_AT, WORK_ORDER_BY, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT) - WORK_ORDER_REF is the column that makes 'one work order per decision' a single-row check (AC-5)

INTERVENTION_OPTION (OPTION_ID key, DECISION_ID, WELL_ID, METHOD, ESTIMATED_GAIN, GAIN_OUOM, ESTIMATED_COST, CURRENCY, RISK, BASIS, BASIS_TEXT, CHOSEN_IND) - the candidates are rows, so the basis and the gain unit are columns that validation can refuse (AC-2, AC-3) and the options that were not chosen stay on the record
R_INTERVENTION_METHOD (METHOD_CODE key, METHOD_NAME, CATEGORY, LIFT_RELATED_IND, ACTIVE_IND) - the method code book; deliberately not seeded, because the methods are the operating company's data
dataModel.registration: FacilityManagementModuleSetup registers the three types; --smoke now reports 386 entity types (up from 383).

evidenceSources.rate: PPDM PDEN_VOL_SUMMARY through PDEN_WELL: the well's last reported day against the mean of up to seven recorded days before it, taking the highest AMENDMENT_SEQ_NO per entity/day/activity and production rows only (the same grain as PRD-01)
evidenceSources.deferment: PRODUCTION_DEFERMENT rows of PRD-03 with END_AT null
evidenceSources.variance: RECONCILIATION_VARIANCE rows of PRD-05 with MATERIAL_IND = 'Y' in the workspace's month, joined on the well dimension
evidenceSources.status: the latest PPDM WELL_STATUS row per well (WEL-04 owns changing it)

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Production/OgInterventions.cs (OgInterventionEvidence, OgInterventionWell, OgInterventionOption, OgInterventionDecision, OgInterventionOptionValues, OgInterventionDecisionValues, OgInterventionPendingWorkOrder, OgInterventionWorkspace, InterventionRules, IOgInterventions, OgInterventionService with LoadAsync/RecordDecisionAsync/CreateWorkOrderAsync/RetryWorkOrderAsync)
implementation.rules: InterventionRules states the three bases, the three risk levels, the seven-day history requirement, the whole validation (well, options, method in the set, no duplicate method, basis, gain unit, non-negative gain/cost, risk level, chosen option, rationale, owner, target date), the confidence rule (a quarter per evidenced check, capped at a half on a conflict) and the lift sentence once, so the page and the tests agree.
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/InterventionsPageView.cs (route 'interventions': well grid with rate/average/change/diagnosis/confidence, the diagnosis panel with evidence, confidence and missing items, the candidate-option builder and grid, the decision bar with chosen option/rationale/owner/target, the decisions grid, the work-order bar with create and retry, and the method reference)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgInterventions), OgApplication.Interventions, catalog 'interventions' (OgModuleKeys.Production), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/InterventionTests.cs (15, no database) + InterventionGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite with the PPDM WELL, WELL_STATUS, PDEN_WELL and PDEN_VOL_SUMMARY tables, PRODUCTION_DEFERMENT (PRD-03), RECONCILIATION_VARIANCE (PRD-05) and the three new tables, seeded in InterventionGatewayTests
integration.ac1_insufficient: WELL-2 has no measurement and no status: its diagnosis reads 'insufficient data: no measured volume for the well; no status recorded ...', with no evidence and 0% confidence, while every other check is named as missing too
integration.ac1_evidence: WELL-1 reads rate 60 bbl against an average of 100 bbl over 7 days (a 40 bbl fall), plus its open EQ-FAIL deferment, plus a material variance at MEASURED of -40 bbl in 2026-10, plus its producing status - four evidenced checks, 100% confidence, three flags
integration.conflict: WELL-3 is recorded SUSPENDED yet measured 100 bbl against an average of 50: both sides are shown, the diagnosis says the evidence conflicts, nothing is resolved automatically and the confidence is capped at 50%
integration.methods: the workspace offers ACIDIZE, ESP and GAS_LIFT and excludes the inactive RETIRED code; an empty reference set reports MethodReferenceMissing and refuses every decision with intervention-method-reference-missing
integration.ac2_basis: an option with no basis is refused with intervention-basis-required, an unknown basis with intervention-basis-invalid, and the chosen GAS_LIFT row stores BASIS=TEST with its BASIS_TEXT ('the gas lift valve test on WELL-7')
integration.ac3_gain: an option with a gain and no unit is refused with intervention-gain-unit-required; the stored chosen option reads '120 bbl'
integration.ac4_decision: a decision with a blank rationale is refused with intervention-rationale-required; the recorded decision stores owner 'sara', the target date, both candidate options and exactly one CHOSEN_IND='Y' row (verified by counting the table)
integration.ac5_workorder: creating the work order 'WO-0001' moves the decision to ACTED and its link reads 'decision <id> -> work order WO-0001'; a second attempt is refused with intervention-work-order-exists naming WO-0001 and the decision count stays 1
integration.ac5_lost: a SQLite trigger blocked the update that records the work order: the call failed, Pending was set with the decision id and 'WO-0002', a re-read showed the decision still DECIDED with no work order, and after the trigger was dropped RetryWorkOrderAsync recorded it once (2 decisions in total)
integration.failed_read: dropping INTERVENTION_OPTION makes LoadAsync fail with a reference and no workspace

gates.AC-1 A diagnosis without evidence says ': pass - the diagnosis carries its evidence items, its missing items and its confidence; with no evidence at all the text reads 'insufficient data' followed by the missing checks, and the gateway test reads that on a well with no measurement and no status.
gates.AC-2 Each option states its basis (test,: pass - BASIS is a required column restricted to TEST, ANALOGUE and MODEL, BASIS_TEXT names the evidence, validation refuses a missing or unknown basis (which is what makes an option without a basis unselectable), and the page refuses to add one.
gates.AC-3 Estimated gain carries a unit: pass - a gain with no GAIN_OUOM is refused with intervention-gain-unit-required, a negative gain is refused, and every gain is printed through the shared formatter so it always shows its unit.
gates.AC-4 A decision records rationale and ow: pass - validation refuses a blank rationale or owner (and a missing target date), both are stored, and the decision grid and detail print the owner, target and rationale.
gates.AC-5 A work order carries the decision a: pass - the work order reference is recorded on the decision row, the record exposes the pair ('decision <id> -> work order <ref>'), a second creation is refused with intervention-work-order-exists, and a creation that is not acknowledged is retained in Pending and retried unchanged.

limits: The work order itself belongs to WRK-01, which is not built. This screen records the reference the decision was raised under and refuses a second one; it does not create a WORK_ORDER row.

The study action from the screens section (an LFT-01 study) is not built either. When the chosen method's reference row says LIFT_RELATED_IND='Y' the page states that a lift-method recommendation belongs to LFT-01 and that this screen records the decision rather than computing a design.

The feature's open question about LiftRecommendationCard is answered as: nothing is computed on the client here. The external packages Vogel and DeclineFitter are not used, because no lift recommendation is computed at all; when LFT-01 exists it is the owner of that calculation.

The confidence is a stated rule (a quarter per evidenced check, capped at a half on a conflict), not a statistical or model-derived score; the plan asks for confidence to be shown without defining how it is computed.

The diagnosis is a read of the records PRD-01, PRD-03, PRD-05 and WEL-04 already wrote. It adds no new measurement and takes no second opinion about a volume: a well with no measurement genuinely has no rate evidence.

A material variance is evidence of a gap, not of its cause, so it is recorded as neutral evidence and does not by itself make a well 'underperforming' - the flag for it names the variance, not a conclusion.
The option list is per decision; re-deciding a well creates a second decision rather than amending the first, so the history of what was decided is kept.
The feature's permissions (production.read, production.intervention.write, work.write) are not enforced per command: the app gates pages.
The three new tables need the ProductionOperations module applied again on an existing database.
